slides.sub: 3 Halloween events at one Randolph park on Sat., Oct. 24, from noon to 9 PM.

slides.title: Trail of Treats
slides.body: A daytime, low-scare trail made for sensory-sensitive guests. Local businesses hand out candy along the way. Paid per child.

slides.title: Trunk or Treat
slides.body: Come in costume and trick-or-treat from decorated car trunks. There are games and photo spots too. Paid per vehicle.

slides.title: Haunted Trail: US Legends
slides.body: An evening haunted trail at the same park, from 6 to 9 PM. The township lists it as a 250th Celebration event.

slides.title: Your Randolph Saturday
slides.tip: Thinking about buying here? Spend a Saturday in town and drive your weekday commute too.

caption:
Living in Randolph? You don't need a big plan this Saturday, just one park.

Veterans Community Park, 100 Calais Rd, has 3 Halloween events on Sat., Oct. 24. Trail of Treats runs noon to 2 PM. Trunk or Treat runs 2:30 to 4:30 PM. The Haunted Trail runs 6 to 9 PM. The rain date is Oct. 25. Check the township's Special Events page for fees and details.
